title: Sap flow sensors installed at Sedgwick Reserve
excerpt: Twelve sap flow sensors are now logging on blue oaks at Sedgwick Reserve.
content: Twelve sap flow sensors are now logging continuously on blue oaks at Sedgwick Reserve, part of a season-long campaign to relate transpiration to soil moisture drawdown across the hillslope. The array will run through the end of the dry season.
